title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (13,105 affected)
summary: ONE OR MORE PAIRS OF THE SIX PROJECTION WELDS THAT ATTACH THE SENDER UNIT RETAINING RING TO THE TANK MAY NOT HAVE BEEN WELDED CORRECTLY.

title: VERITRANS SPECIALTY VEHICLES, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM (192 affected)
summary: THE FLUORESCENT LIGHT CIRCUIT DIODE, LOCATED UNDER THE DRIVER'S SEAT, CAN OVERHEAT.

title: AMEREX CORPORATION: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (96 affected)
summary: THE VEHICLE OPERATOR IS ABLE TO SILENCE THE AUDIBLE ALARM WHICH WARNS OF "TRACE" AND "MODERATE" LEVELS OF METHANE DETECTION.

title: Utility Trailer Manufacturing Company: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (421 affected)
summary: THE VERTICAL AND HORIZONTAL WELDS ON THE CARGO TIE DOWN DEVICES WERE NOT PROPERLY WELDED.

title: Fulmer Helmets, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:HELMETS (5,119 affected)
summary: THE QUICK RELEASE CHIN STRAP SYSTEM CAN OPEN WITHOUT BOTH BUTTONS BEING DEPRESSED.

title: INDIANA MILLS, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM (423 affected)
summary: THE HEX SPACER ASSEMBLY WHICH EXTENDS THE SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE CAN SEPARATE AT STATIC LOADS OF 4,000 POUNDS. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINTER/BRAKES:AIR SUPPLY SYSTEM (317 affected)
summary: THE PRIMARY AIR RESERVOIR CAN RUPTURE DUE TO INADEQUATE SEAM WELDS.

title: General Motors, LLC: WHEELS (22,361 affected)
summary: CRACKS DEVELOP IN THE WHEEL MOUNTING SURFACE. IF THESE CRACKS BECOME SEVERE ENOUGH, THE WHEEL WILL COMPLETELY SEPARATE FROM THE VEHICLE.

title: Airstream, Inc.: FUEL:LPG CONTAINER (TANK) ATTACHMENTS (STRAPS/BOLT (150 affected)
summary: THE LP TANK CAN PIVOT IN ITS MOUNTING BRACKET AND WORK LOOSE.

title: BUELL-out of business: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEMS (1,226 affected)
summary: FUEL SEEPAGE CAN OCCUR AT THE MOLD PARTING LINE OR AT THE AREA WHERE THE PETCOCK ATTACHES TO THE FUEL TANK.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:IDLER AND ATTACHMENT (175 affected)
summary: TWO BOLTS ATTACHING THE UPPER STEERING ARM TO THE FRONT STEERING AXLE WERE NOT TIGHTENED PROPERLY.

title: ADVANCE MIXER, INC.: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:DRUM AND SHOE SYSTEMS (28 affected)
summary: THE MACHINING PERFORMED ON THE BRAKE DRUMS WILL NOT PERMIT THE DRUM TO SEAT FULLY AGAINST THE HUB FACE. THE REDUCED BRAKE DRUM AND HUB CONTACT AREA WILL ABRADE AND FRET ALLOWING THE WHEEL MOUNTING JOINT TO LOOSEN.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART (82 affected)
summary: THE WIRES OF A 12-VOLT SOLENOID LOCATED INSIDE THE SIDE PLATE BEHIND THE DRIVER'S SEAT CAN SHORT ON THE SOLENOID CASE.

title: FRUEHAUF CORPORATION: WINNEBAGO/EQUIPMENT: CERTIFICATION LABEL (59 affected)
summary: THE CERTIFICATION LABEL ON THESE VEHICLES HAS INCORRECT TIRE PRESSURE DATA. A TIRE PRESSURE RATING OF 110 PSI WAS LISTED FOR BOTH FRONT AND REAR TIRES. THE PROPER TIRE PRESSURE VALUES ARE 90 PSI FRONT AND 80 PSI REAR.

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:AIR DRYER (3,500 affected)
summary: AIR SYSTEM BLOCKAGE IN THE AIR DRYER OCCURS DEGRADING THE MOISTURE REMOVING CAPABILITIES OF THE DRYER WHEN THE VEHICLE IS OPERATED IN A COLD ENVIRONMENT AND MOISTURE ACCUMULATES AND FREEZES IN THE AIR DRYER OR IN THE LINE BETWEEN THE DRYER AND THE AIR SYSTEM RESERVOIR. THE AIR DRYER CAN BECOME OVERPRESSURIZED CAUSING THE AIR DRYER CARTRIDGE TO SEPARATE FROM THE MOUNTING BASE.

title: A. GIRARDIN INC.: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST (386 affected)
summary: PASSENGERS' CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: Evenflo Company, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT: INDEPENDENT (193,332 affected)
summary: THESE INFANT CHILD SEATS DO NOT MEET THE SLED TEST REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS," WHEN TESTED WITHOUT THE DETACHABLE AUTOBASE.

title: MIRADA: FUEL:CNG: PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE/DEVICE (15,590 affected)
summary: SOME TEMPERATURE SENSITIVE TRIGGERS WERE NOT X-RAYED. THESE TRIGGERS COULD CONTAIN INTERNAL VOIDS THAT WOULD MAKE THE TRIGGERS SUSCEPTIBLE TO ADVANCED CREEP CAUSING FALSE ACTIVATION AND VENTING OF THE CNG.

title: Land Rover: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (2,114 affected)
summary: A FLEXIBLE BRAKE HOSE THAT CONNECTS THE HYDRAULIC PUMP TO THE ANTI-LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS) VALVE BLOCK ASSEMBLY CAN LEAK CAUSING LOSS OF BRAKE FLUID.

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: WHEEL CHAIR SEAT BELT RETRACTORS (36 affected)
summary: THE WEBBED BELT RETRACTORS USED TO SECURE A WHEEL CHAIR IN THE BUS FAIL WHEN THE PLASTIC RETRACTOR COVER SEPARATES ALLOWING THE COVER TO OPEN.  THIS CAN ALLOW THE INTERNAL RETRACTOR SPRING TO RELEASE OUT OF THE RETRACTOR.

title: MARMON MOTOR COMPANY: BRAKES:AIR DRYER (190 affected)
summary: AIR SYSTEM BLOCKAGE IN THE AIR DRYER OCCURS DEGRADING THE MOISTURE REMOVING CAPABILITIES OF THE DRYER WHEN THE VEHICLE IS OPERATED IN A COLD ENVIRONMENT AND MOISTURE ACCUMULATES AND FREEZES IN THE AIR DRYER OR IN THE LINE BETWEEN THE DRYER AND THE AIR SYSTEM RESERVOIR. THE AIR DRYER CAN BECOME OVERPRESSURIZED CAUSING THE AIR DRYER CARTRIDGE TO SEPARATE FROM THE MOUNTING BASE.

title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: ENGINE:OTHER PARTS (215 affected)
summary: TWO LATCHES MOUNTED ON EACH SIDE OF THE REAR ENGINE ACCESS COVER AND SECURE THE COVER WHEN THE MOTORHOME IS IN TRANSIT WERE NOT POSITIONED CORRECTLY.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: STEERING:LINKAGES:TIE ROD:END (14 affected)
summary: DURING ASSEMBLY, THE TIE ROD END NUTS WERE NOT PROPERLY TORQUED. EXTREMELY LOW TORQUE CAN ALLOW MOVEMENT BETWEEN THE BALL STUD AND THE TIE ROD ARM CAUSING DAMAGE.

title: VEHICLE SAFETY MANUFACTURING, LLC: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:BRAKE LIGHTS (350 affected)
summary: THESE LAMPS DO NOT MEET THE REFLEX FUNCTION OF FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: FRUEHAUF CORPORATION: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT BEARING:WHEEL (13 affected)
summary: AN INNER WHEEL BEARING CONE MAY BE MISSING ON SOME OF THESE TRAILERS.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES (265,000 affected)
summary: THE FRONT SAFETY BELT BUCKLE RELEASE BUTTONS CAN BREAK. THESE RED PLASTIC RELEASE BUTTONS ARE MARKED "PRESS." IF A BUTTON BREAKS, PIECES CAN FALL INTO THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY CAUSING THE BUCKLE TO OPERATE IMPROPERLY.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:FLEXIBLE (21,742 affected)
summary: THE WIRE END OF THE HAND THROTTLE CABLE PASSES THROUGH A SPLIT PLASTIC GROMMET IN THE ACCELERATOR ROD. THIS WIRE CAN WORK THROUGH THE SLOT IN THE GROMMET AND BECOME LODGED BETWEEN THE GROMMET AND THE EDGE OF THE HOLE IN THE ACCELERATOR ROD.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): FUEL: VEHICLE CRASH, CUT OFF SYSTEM (5-94) (54,388 affected)
summary: THE SENSOR'S PLASTIC CASE MATERIAL CAN LEAK ALLOWING THE SENSOR TO SHUT OFF THE ENGINE UNEXPECTEDLY DURING ABRUPT TURNS OR WHEN RIDING OVER BUMPY SURFACES.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: BRAKES:AIR DRYER (1,224 affected)

title: CAGIVA NORTH AMERICA: SUSPENSION:MOTORCYCLE REAR (200 affected)
summary: THE WRONG REAR AXLE SCREWS WERE INSTALLED ON SOME OF THESE MOTORCYCLES.

title: Pierce Manufacturing: BRAKES:AIR DRYER (4 affected)
summary: AIR SYSTEM BLOCKAGE IN THE AIR DRYER OCCURS DEGRADING THE MOISTURE REMOVING CAPABILITIES OF THE DRYER WHEN THE VEHICLE IS OPERATED IN A COLD ENVIRONMENT AND MOISTURE ACCUMULATES AND FREEZES IN THE AIR DRYER OR IN THE LINE BETWEEN THE DRYER AND THE AIR SYSTEM RESERVOIR. THE AIR DRYER CAN BECOME OVERPRESSURIZED CAUSING THE AIR DRYER CARTRIDGE TO SEPARATE FROM THE MOUNTING BASE.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: WHEELS (62 affected)
summary: THESE WHEELS ARE COMPOSED OF 2 PIECES - A DISC AND A RIM WHICH ARE NORMALLY WELDED TOGETHER. THESE WHEELS LACK THE SPECIFIED FILLET WELDS.
